title: Quiet workspace
passage: Could you turn the music down a little? A. Turn left at the next street. B. The concert tickets sold out. C. Of course, I did not realize it was bothering you.
passageZh:
可以把音樂調小聲一點嗎？
A. 下一條街左轉。
B. 演唱會門票賣完了。
C. 當然，我不知道它打擾到你。
audioScript: Could you turn the music down a little? A. Turn left at the next street. B. The concert tickets sold out. C. Of course, I did not realize it was bothering you.
